source_note: The reference shows no tent and no camp: it is a campfire beside a palisade; draw only one campsite and nothing else, no palisade, no figures; use the reference only for the colours of the fire
design: a small camp of one low canvas lean-to on two timber poles, a bedroll under it, and a small campfire of orange flame on a ring of stones in front

variants.note: the lean-to open toward the camera, the campfire in front of the opening
